title: RAW_UNSCREENED: otedy/qotedy teilen einen Stamm mit Rollenwechsel
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f85r1.2-.3 place otedy repeatedly beside qotedy and end with otam/otedam; a stem-plus-q branch could preserve one content node while changing a local role, against a whole-lexeme or line-template rival.

design.scope_description: Only f85r1.1-.6 plus f77r/f80v occurrences of exact otedy/qotedy/otedam-family forms in the exposed packet; no outside gloss or reserve data.
design.mechanism: The written otedy stem is a content-building unit; qotedy is a q-prefixed role variant and terminal -am in otam/otedam/tdam is a bounded output form. No English value is assigned.
design.unit: Exact words and source groups f85r1.2 G004/G010 otedy, f85r1.3 G002/G006/G008 otedy/qotedy and line-final otam/otedam; f85r1.5 tdam is a terminal control.
design.contrast: Stem-preserving q/terminal branching versus unrelated whole words or a paragraph-line template that independently favors repeated otedy and -am endings.
design.prediction: A stem account predicts that otedy and qotedy share the same immediate content-neighbor class while q presence changes a declared slot/role, and that -am forms preserve the preceding stem relation at line end across at least two f85r1 lines. The whole-lexeme/template rival predicts no joint stem factor once line position and repetition are controlled.
concrete_observations: f85r1.2 is yoiin cheey qocthdy otedy dol ar aiin okshd okchedy otedy chckhdy otam.
f85r1.3 is tarar otedy opcheey ykdair chy qotedy qokchdy otedy cheol saiin otedam.
f85r1.5 ends ... oraiin olshedy okchy kedy tedy tdam; f77r.11 separately has qoteedy ... oteedy, retained as a near-form control rather than an equivalence.
linked_consequences: The qotedy occurrence in f85r1.3 should occupy the same stem-neighbor inventory as the three otedy occurrences, with only the predeclared q-conditioned slot difference.
otam and otedam should share a line-final terminal configuration while preserving distinct stem material; a positive result must survive comparison to f85r/f80v line-final -y forms.
design.nearest_rival: otedy, qotedy, otam and otedam are independent lexemes or a line-final formula; apparent stem overlap carries no content relation.
design.distinguishing_observation: Score exact stem overlap, q presence, terminal ending and neighbor/line position in the full exposed paragraph before any gloss. Mixed positions or a single-page result favor the rival and stop the route.
assumption_costs: f85r1 repeated forms are not merely a template
design.strongest_likely_failure: All informative instances cluster on one physical paragraph and line ends, so position or formula may explain every apparent branch; no semantic anchor is supplied.
